extra_vocab.en: good or better than usual for you
extra_vocab.note: 在這篇裡 favorable group rate 指對團體客人有利的優惠房價，是飯店業務信常見的正面說法，語氣客氣又帶一點促銷意味。

example.en: We negotiated a favorable rate for the conference rooms.
example.zh: 我們談到了會議室的優惠費率。

example.en: The bank offered us favorable terms on the new loan.
example.zh: 銀行提供我們新貸款的有利條件。

example.en: The new manager made a favorable impression on the whole team.
example.zh: 新經理給整個團隊留下良好的印象。

example.en: The hotel received a favorable review in a travel magazine.
example.zh: 這家飯店在旅遊雜誌上獲得好評。

examples.en: The supplier gave us a favorable price for the first order.
examples.zh: 供應商給了我們首批訂單一個優惠的價格。

examples.en: Customer feedback on the new menu has been very favorable so far.
examples.zh: 到目前為止，顧客對新菜單的回應非常正面。

examples.en: Weather conditions are favorable for the outdoor event this weekend.
examples.zh: 這個週末的天氣條件適合舉辦戶外活動。

confusable.diff: favorite 是「最喜歡的」，favorable 是「有利的、讚許的」，兩者發音和拼法很像但意思不同。

example.en: Pasta is the favorite dish among our visiting clients.
example.zh: 義大利麵是來訪客戶最喜歡的菜色。

similar.diff: reasonable 是「價格合理、不貴」，favorable 則是「比一般更有利」，語氣更正面。

example.en: The hotel offers a reasonable price for large groups.
example.zh: 這家飯店對大型團體提供合理的價格。

example.en: The audit gave us positive results this quarter.
example.zh: 這一季的稽核給了我們正面的結果。

example.en: The new schedule is beneficial to all staff.
example.zh: 新的時程表對所有員工都有益。

example.en: Your proposal is acceptable to the board.
example.zh: 你的提案董事會可以接受。

derived.link: favorable 的詞幹；favor 是「好意、幫忙」，加 -able 就變成「值得讚許的、有利的」
favorable + -ly，形容詞變副詞，像 quick → quickly
favor + -ite，「被偏愛的」，也可當名詞「最愛」

senses.en: good or better than usual for you
senses.distinguish: 後面常接 rate、price、terms 等商業字眼。

example.en: Our favorable rate is available only to groups of ten or more.
example.zh: 我們的優惠費率只提供十人以上的團體。

senses.en: showing that you like or approve of something
senses.distinguish: 後面常接 opinion、review、response，表示人的看法。

example.en: Most customers gave a favorable opinion of the new service.
example.zh: 大多數顧客對新服務給予正面的評價。

senses.distinguish: 後面常接 conditions，說明環境適合做某件事。

example.en: Market conditions are favorable for launching a new product.
example.zh: 市場情勢適合推出新產品。

extra_vocab.en: a kind or polite thing that you do for someone
extra_vocab.note: 在這篇裡 As a courtesy to your group 表示飯店出於好意、額外提供的免費服務。常見於飯店、航空公司的客氣說法。
extra_vocab.grammar_note: courtesy 是名詞，要形容人時用 courteous；表示「由…提供」要用 courtesy of。

example.en: Free parking and coffee are small courtesies that guests appreciate.
example.zh: 免費停車和咖啡是客人很欣賞的小服務。

example.en: As a courtesy, we will hold your room until six o'clock.
example.zh: 出於好意，我們會替您保留房間到六點。

example.en: A courtesy shuttle takes guests to the convention center every hour.
example.zh: 免費接駁車每小時載客人到會議中心。

example.en: The manager made a courtesy call to thank the client.
example.zh: 經理打了一通禮貌性電話向客戶道謝。

example.en: The tickets were provided courtesy of our main sponsor.
example.zh: 這些票券由我們的主要贊助商提供。

examples.en: The fee waiver is a courtesy, not something guests can expect.
examples.zh: 免收費用是一種好意，不是客人可以期待的權利。

examples.en: Thank you for your courtesy and patience during the system upgrade.
examples.zh: 感謝您在系統升級期間的體諒與耐心。

examples.en: Our staff treat every guest with courtesy and respect.
examples.zh: 我們的員工以禮貌和尊重對待每位客人。

confusable.diff: courtesy 是名詞（禮貌、好意），courteous 是形容詞（有禮貌的）。
confusable.usage: 形容人或態度要用 courteous，例如 a courteous driver；不能說 a courtesy driver（那是「接駁服務的司機」）。

example.en: All of our drivers are courteous and arrive on time.
example.zh: 我們所有的司機都很有禮貌而且準時抵達。

similar.diff: complimentary 是形容詞，意思是「免費贈送的」，用來修飾 breakfast、upgrade 等名詞。

example.en: Guests receive a complimentary breakfast every morning.
example.zh: 客人每天早上都有免費早餐。

similar.diff: favor 是幫別人的忙，較個人化；courtesy 偏向機構或服務上的禮遇。

example.en: As a favor, the vendor delivered the parts on Sunday.
example.zh: 供應商特別幫忙，在星期日送來了零件。

example.en: Politeness is important when you speak with customers.
example.zh: 與顧客交談時，禮貌很重要。

example.en: She earned the respect of her colleagues quickly.
example.zh: 她很快就贏得同事的尊重。

example.en: Thank you for your kindness during our visit.
example.zh: 感謝您在我們拜訪期間的親切招待。

derived.link: courtesy 的形容詞，字尾 -ous 像 curious、serious
courteous + -ly，形容詞變副詞，像 quick → quickly

senses.en: something extra that is given to be kind
senses.distinguish: 常和 free、as a courtesy 一起出現，指額外給的服務。

example.en: Free coffee in the lobby is a courtesy of the hotel.
example.zh: 大廳的免費咖啡是飯店提供的一項禮遇。

senses.distinguish: 常接 with courtesy，指待人的態度。

example.en: Please answer every customer call with courtesy.
example.zh: 請以禮貌的態度接聽每一通客戶來電。

extra_vocab.en: a place where people go to relax with massage and other treatments
extra_vocab.note: 在這篇裡指飯店內的水療設施，信中提到客人第二晚可免費使用，是額外的招待。spa 前面通常加 the 指飯店內的那間。

example.en: Several hotels in the area have spas open to the public.
example.zh: 這一區有好幾家飯店的水療中心對外開放。

example.en: Each guest receives one free spa treatment during the stay.
example.zh: 每位客人住宿期間可獲得一次免費水療護理。

example.en: We booked a spa package for the entire sales team.
example.zh: 我們替整個業務團隊訂了水療套裝方案。

example.en: The hotel's spa facilities include a sauna and a pool.
example.zh: 飯店的水療設施包括三溫暖和泳池。

example.en: The company organized a spa day to thank its staff.
example.zh: 公司安排了一天水療日來感謝員工。

examples.en: Guests can book a massage at the hotel spa this weekend.
examples.zh: 客人這個週末可以預約飯店水療中心的按摩。

examples.en: The resort spa offers special packages for corporate groups.
examples.zh: 度假村的水療中心為企業團體提供特別方案。

examples.en: The spa will be closed for cleaning on Monday morning.
examples.zh: 水療中心星期一早上將因清潔而關閉。

similar.diff: health club 以健身房和運動課程為主，spa 則以放鬆的按摩和護理為主。

example.en: The hotel health club has a gym and a swimming pool.
example.zh: 飯店的健身俱樂部有健身房和游泳池。

similar.diff: wellness center 範圍較廣，除了放鬆還包含健康諮詢和運動課程，語氣較正式。

example.en: The wellness center offers yoga classes and massage services.
example.zh: 健康中心提供瑜伽課程和按摩服務。

example.en: The hotel offers a one-hour massage for guests.
example.zh: 飯店為客人提供一小時的按摩。

example.en: The sauna is open from six to ten every evening.
example.zh: 三溫暖每天晚上六點到十點開放。

example.en: Guests may use the gym at any time of day.
example.zh: 客人可以在一天中任何時間使用健身房。

senses.en: a place with massage and other treatments for relaxing
senses.distinguish: 常出現在飯店設施介紹，後面接 treatment、package。

example.en: The spa on the top floor has a view of the harbor.
example.zh: 頂樓的水療中心可以看到海港景色。

senses.en: a town with natural hot water where people go for their health
senses.distinguish: 指整個地區，常有 spa town、spa resort 的說法。

example.en: The town is a famous spa known for its hot springs.
example.zh: 這個小鎮是以溫泉聞名的療養勝地。

extra_vocab.en: to promise that something will happen or be true
extra_vocab.note: 在這篇裡 We cannot guarantee the rate after that date 是委婉但明確的提醒：二月十日之後不保證仍是這個價格。用 cannot guarantee 比直接說 will change 更客氣。
extra_vocab.grammar_note: guarantee 後面可接名詞、that 子句或 to V，例如 guarantee delivery、guarantee that it will arrive、guarantee to reply；也可用雙受詞 guarantee you a seat。

example.en: The contract guarantees delivery within five business days.
example.zh: 這份合約保證在五個工作天內交貨。

example.en: We offer written guarantees on all of our office equipment.
example.zh: 我們對所有辦公設備都提供書面保證。

example.en: The airline guaranteed every passenger a seat on the next flight.
example.zh: 航空公司保證每位乘客在下一班飛機有座位。

example.en: Customers receive guaranteed delivery within two days of ordering.
example.zh: 顧客下單後兩天內保證送達。

example.en: Guaranteeing on-time delivery is our top priority this year.
example.zh: 保證準時交貨是我們今年的首要任務。

example.en: The software comes with a thirty-day money-back guarantee.
example.zh: 這套軟體附有三十天退款保證。

example.en: We guarantee delivery to any address in the country.
example.zh: 我們保證送達全國任何地址。

example.en: A credit card number will guarantee your reservation overnight.
example.zh: 提供信用卡號可以擔保您整晚的訂房。

example.en: There is no guarantee that prices will stay the same.
example.zh: 無法保證價格會維持不變。

examples.en: Please book early, because we cannot guarantee a room later.
examples.zh: 請及早預訂，因為之後我們無法保證有房間。

examples.en: The supplier guarantees that all parts will arrive by Friday.
examples.zh: 供應商保證所有零件在星期五前送到。

examples.en: This printer comes with a two-year guarantee against defects.
examples.zh: 這台印表機附有兩年的瑕疵保固。

confusable.diff: ensure 是「確保、設法使一定發生」，著重做法；guarantee 是「保證」，著重承諾。
confusable.usage: ensure 後面通常接 that 子句，不用於「保固」這種名詞意思；guarantee 可當名詞，ensure 只能當動詞。

example.en: Please ensure that all doors are locked before you leave.
example.zh: 離開前請確認所有的門都已上鎖。

confusable.diff: insure 是「投保、為…保險」，和 guarantee 的「承諾」不同。

example.en: The company insured the shipment against damage during transport.
example.zh: 公司為這批貨物投保運送途中的損壞險。

similar.diff: promise 是日常的「答應」，語氣較個人；guarantee 更正式，常有合約或書面保證的感覺。

example.en: The vendor promised to send the samples on Monday.
example.zh: 廠商答應星期一寄出樣品。

similar.diff: assure 後面接人再接 that 子句，意思是「向某人保證、使放心」。

example.en: She assured the client that the work would finish on time.
example.zh: 她向客戶保證工作會準時完成。

example.en: The warranty covers repairs for two years.
example.zh: 保固涵蓋兩年的維修。

example.en: We promise to reply to every email within a day.
example.zh: 我們承諾每封電子郵件一天內回覆。

example.en: The company has a strong commitment to quality.
example.zh: 這家公司對品質有堅定的承諾。

example.en: We guarantee that every order will ship within two days.
example.zh: 我們保證每筆訂單兩天內出貨。

example.en: Do you offer a guarantee on installation work?
example.zh: 你們的安裝工程有提供保證嗎？

senses.en: to promise that something will happen
senses.distinguish: 後面接事情或 that 子句，重點在承諾結果。

example.en: The manager guarantees that the report will be ready tomorrow.
example.zh: 經理保證報告明天會準備好。

senses.en: to promise to fix or replace a product if it breaks
senses.distinguish: 受詞是產品，常接 for + 期間 或 against + 瑕疵。

example.en: The company guarantees its laptops against defects for three years.
example.zh: 公司對筆記型電腦提供三年瑕疵保固。
